# DeployVet

> DeployVet gives a free outside-in security and bug check for an app you built, including apps made with Lovable, Bolt, Replit, Cursor, and other AI or no-code tools. The main paid offer is a one-time $60 "We fix it for you" service: fixed within 48 hours of getting access, or your money back. Run by Hayden Young. It is not a penetration test, an audit, or a certification.

DeployVet looks at a live site the way a visitor would and reports common problems anyone can already see. You get a score out of 100, a grade, and a plain description. Findings and scores are rule-based. A clean result means those checks found nothing; it is not a guarantee the app is safe. Only check a site you own or were asked to look after.

## Free check

Start at [https://deployvet.com/](https://deployvet.com/), paste the app address, and press "Check it free". No signup and no card. The homepage calls it a free 10-second check. The pricing page says it is one outside check per site each month, with a score, a grade, a summary, and the most important finding in full with its fix.

What it looks at, from the homepage and the methodology page:

- API keys and secrets left in public page code
- Supabase or Firebase databases that anyone can read, including a public Supabase key that allows anonymous reads
- HTTPS, HTTP redirects, mixed content, and certificate problems
- Missing security headers, and exposed files and routes such as environment files, `.git`, backups, source maps, and admin or API routes that answer without a login
- Broken links, missing pages, and basic search-visibility items such as titles, descriptions, robots.txt, and sitemaps

The how-it-works page says the exact change for a high or critical problem stays with the paid fix. It does not log in, test business logic, or try to break in. Details: [Methodology](https://deployvet.com/methodology.html) and [How we grade](https://deployvet.com/how-we-grade.html).

## We fix it for you ($60)

One-time payment in US dollars. Nothing renews. You pay on Stripe, and DeployVet does not see the card.

- Run the free check first
- DeployVet fixes what that check found, in your project
- After you pay, you say how to get in (a GitHub invite or a collaborator invite). A DNS record is not required before work starts
- Fixed within 48 hours of getting access, or your money back. Access means a working GitHub invite or collaborator invite. The 48 hours start then, not when you pay
- If that deadline is missed, email support@deployvet.com and the $60 is refunded. Refunds are not automatic. Policy: [Refunds](https://deployvet.com/refunds.html)

## Who it is for

- People checking an app they made, including apps built with Lovable, Bolt, Replit, Cursor, Vercel, Netlify, and other AI or no-code tools. The checkout form also lists v0 and Bubble
- Any public website, hand-coded or built with an AI or no-code tool, that you own or were asked to look after. Sites that use Supabase get extra database checks
- The about page also describes the same check for freelancers, agencies, and the clients they build for. The how-it-works page says the check itself is built for one person looking at their own app

## Who it is not for

- Anyone who needs a penetration test, a security audit, a compliance certification, or a legal sign-off
- Checking a site you do not own and were not asked to look after

## Other prices still on the site

The pricing page still sells these in addition to the free check and the $60 fix. The how-it-works page says the $7 Scan is still there. It is a written report, not a fix.

- Scan: $7 one-time. You pay first, prove you own the site unless it was already verified, then an automated check runs. Every finding with evidence and a fix, fix prompts, and a link to a report you can print or save as a PDF. It can also read a public repository or database project you share. Read-only
- Fix it pack: $10 one-time, for one site. The Scan plus 30 days of one-click re-checks and score history. Nothing renews
- DeployVet Pro: $29 per month, for up to 5 sites, with a weekly check and an email when something new shows up. Cancel any time
- Launch Pack: $39 one-time. Marketing copy for one site (a landing-page rewrite, five posts for X, two for LinkedIn, and a launch email), written with AI and delivered within 48 hours. Not a security service, and it does not promise traffic or sales

The [fixes page](https://deployvet.com/fixes.html) says the usual offer on the check is still the $60 fix. It also lists larger jobs agreed before any work starts: a $150 quick fix, a $300 standard fix, and a full cleanup quoted from $400.

- [Supabase RLS check for AI-built apps](https://deployvet.com/guides/supabase-rls-check-for-ai-apps.html): open tables and weak policies in Lovable, Bolt, Cursor, or Replit apps

- [Stripe success page is not proof of payment](https://deployvet.com/guides/stripe-success-page-is-not-proof-of-payment.html): do not unlock paid features just because someone opened /success

- [How do I know if my website was hacked?](https://deployvet.com/guides/how-do-i-know-if-my-website-was-hacked.html): signs a site owner can check, and what to do next
- [Is my website secure? A 15-minute check](https://deployvet.com/guides/is-my-website-secure.html): six checks a site owner can do, and what an outside check adds
- [My SSL certificate expired: what to do](https://deployvet.com/guides/ssl-certificate-expired-what-to-do.html): find who handles the certificate, renew it, and check every version of the address
- [Exposed JavaScript source maps: how to check and fix](https://deployvet.com/guides/exposed-javascript-source-maps.html): how a public source map shows your original code, and how to turn maps off
